candidate.description: CArrEntry.size controls a loop that dereferences CArrEntry.head without checking negative/positive bounds or null head.

limitations: The harness copies the conversion function and uses local type stubs.
Windows access violation is not a platform vulnerability confirmation.
FFI caller reachability and process privilege boundary remain unverified.
next_gate: Build or obtain a complete OpenHarmony FFI library and run the malformed input cases in an isolated process.

validation_evidence.asan: WSL Clang 21.1.8; zero-page SEGV for null head in both conversion paths; controls normal

oh_source.l4_evidence: L4 源级定位（L4_TIER_C + kv_null_entry 执行件）：FFI 侧以 CArray/CJByteArray 形态传入键值数据，C++ 侧 distributed_kv_store 接口在 entry/data 为空数组时未做空校验即遍历。 pinned 树的 FfiOHOSDistributedKVStoreCreateKVManager ABI 为 (const char*, Context*)——无错误出参且 Context 无法在纯 C 侧构造（2026-09-28 真库实测：历史 ABI 形态调用即 SIGSEGV），记录为隔离限制并以 tools/validation_cases/kv_null_entry.c 执行件保留 malformed 入口矩阵（run_malformed.sh）。

fix_recommendation: 建议 CArrStrToVectorKey/String 族 FFI 转换（同文件 3 处）在 length>0 时校验数组指针非空并返回参数校验错误码；本案为源级归档口径（AbilityRuntime Context 隔离限制，如实记录，见 docs/status/TASK_IPC_KV_VALIDATION_20260928.md）。
reproduction_commands: 等价运行级（WSL Clang 21.1.8 ASan/UBSan，驱动 kv_null_entry.c）：两条转换路径 null head 均 zero-page SEGV，对照组正常；未做真库链接（如实区分等价级与真库级）。
